verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages list 'Comprehensive e-Filing Services' under the Apply sections for Designs and Trade Marks and in the patents E-Services navigation, described as an online filing and status rail. Fees are also published by filing mode, so online filing is the product's own documented capability. The evidence is mostly navigation labels, though, and does not show the full transaction being completed online, including fee payment. missing for 10: explicit documentation that filing and fee payment can be completed end-to-end online, detail on the e-filing workflow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed online filing.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Trade Marks ... Apply ... Comprehensive e-Filing Services
an online filing and status rail
amounts by filing mode, not a contact form
